workarounds.symptom: bug(config): mcp.yaml and custom agent files are read with the locale encoding on native Windows
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(config): read mcp.yaml and custom agent files as UTF-8. Target files: src/ouroboros/orchestrator/mcp_config.py, src/ouroboros/plugin/agents/registry.py, tests/unit/orchestrator/test_mcp_config.py. . `load_mcp_config()` and `AgentRegistry._parse_agent_md()` now read their user-written files as UTF-8 on every locale, and a non-UTF-8 `mcp.yaml` comes back as `Result.err(ConfigError)` instead of an uncaught `UnicodeDecodeError`. Same treatment #1831 / #1841 gave `config.yaml` and `credentials.yaml`. (Ref: https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/pull/2821)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] LiteLLM adapter sends top_p/temperature to OpenAI reasoning models
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(providers): omit sampling for OpenAI reasoning models. Target files: src/ouroboros/providers/litellm_adapter.py, src/ouroboros/providers/litellm_proof_worker.py, src/ouroboros/providers/openai_sampling.py. Direct OpenAI reasoning requests through LiteLLM can fail before reaching the API because the adapter always supplies sampling controls that the model rejects. Omit `temperature` and `top_p` when an o-series or GPT-5 reasoning model cannot use them, while preserving the requested reasoning effort. (Ref: https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/pull/2819)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] LiteLLM adapter sends a bare JSON schema as response_format.json_schema
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(providers): wrap bare JSON schema for LiteLLM response_format. Target files: src/ouroboros/providers/litellm_adapter.py, tests/unit/providers/test_anthropic_55_requests.py, tests/unit/providers/test_litellm_adapter.py. The LiteLLM adapter forwarded `response_format` unchanged, so callers that pass a bare schema as `json_schema` (consensus vote, QA, semantic evaluation, drift) sent OpenAI-style routes a `json_schema` without `name`/`schema`, and LiteLLM's Anthropic path raised `KeyError: 'schema'`.
